source_clause: ICE9.) Climate off has on/off state that is indicated on HC, TS (climate screen) and in status bar. When the system is turned off, show the CLIMATE OFF screen with the OFF button turned into an ON button and grey out remaining buttons except for Front/Max defrost and rear defrost. The Main category control shows fan speed segments off and mode Oscar replaced with "OFF" which will remain until the user turns it back on. Temperatures and units (°F/C) in status bar are substituted by dashes in all modes when climate is off. Actions on rear defrost, heated/vented seats or heated wheel don t reactivate climate (climate still off). Actions on any other climate hard controls turns system back on. When climate is OFF, the recirculation LED of the hard control is on. Action on the recirculation hard control will not turn system back on; it simply opens the recirculation and turns led off. If a user presses a temp/fan hard control to turn climate back on, the system reinstates to the last level of that feature and the climate system turns back on (does not happen with recirculation, rear defrost, heated/vented seats or heated wheel). If the user continues to hold/turn the control, the system will respond in-kind.
reasoning: 驗證目標：16.10（ICE9）以八句定出 ICS 介面之 climate off 呈現、按鈕灰化例外、狀態列破折號、各類硬鍵之回復行為，以及 recirculation LED 之特例，八個 037 leaf 逐句對應。關鍵情境條件：EMEA 軸取正向值；`115-01`（灰化例外）另補第五軸與第十軸，`115-04`（座椅／方向盤動作）另補第十六軸（Comfort Features，出處 17.3）；依 **R-C34** 第九軸與第十三軸暴露 → 全數補。為什麼這樣切：`115-04`（不回復）與 `115-05`（回復）為同一組規則之兩側，其失效可獨立發生。刻意略過：**`115-06` 之 recirculation LED 特例為 ch16 獨有** —— 鏡射表記 `16.10 ↔ 2.10` 為 `mirrored` 而註明「ICE9 另加 recirculation LED 兩句」，C11 無之，故該條**不對應任何 ch2 之 TC**，亦不得反向移植至 ch2（§8.2.1）。

interface_axis_review.observable_interface: CLIMATE OFF 畫面、main category control、status bar 與硬鍵之 LED
interface_axis_review.axis_9: 暴露 → 全數補 —— 可觀察量在 head unit 之 comfort section（6.3 使其移除）；**與批次 11 相反**，該批之可觀察量為 comfort popup，正是 6.3 之例外
interface_axis_review.axis_12: 不暴露 —— ch16 十八節無 tab 條文
interface_axis_review.axis_13: 暴露 → 全數補（出處 2.14 C15，跨節取據 R-C29）
interface_axis_review.emea_ics: **不適用（反向）** —— 本節屬 ch16，取**正向**軸值 PC（出處 16.2）而非排除式；R-C36-1 於本側之對應問題為「本條於非 EMEA 車輛上有無對象」，答為無

tcs.tc_title: Climate off shows on the hard control screen and status bar
tcs.test_item: Climate off shall have an on/off state that is indicated on HC, TS and in the status bar
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The vehicle is an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified in chapter 16 (16.2)
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not configured with a non-foldable secondary lower screen containing comfort information, for which the comfort section is removed from the head unit (6.3)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Turn the climate system off using the climate power hard control
2. Read the climate screen and the status bar
tcs.expected_result:
1. The climate power hard control shows the off state
2. The CLIMATE OFF screen is displayed and the status bar shows the climate as off
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)

tcs.tc_title: Only the defrost buttons stay available while climate is off
tcs.test_item: When the system is turned off the OFF button shall turn into an ON button and the remaining buttons shall be greyed out except for Front/Max defrost and rear defrost
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The vehicle is an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified in chapter 16 (16.2)
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle is equipped with MAX DEF (3.2)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle is equipped with rear defrost, which is absent on some soft top vehicles (3.4)
4. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
5. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not configured with a non-foldable secondary lower screen containing comfort information, for which the comfort section is removed from the head unit (6.3)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Turn the climate system off using the climate power button on the climate screen
2. Read the power button and the "MAX DEF" and "REAR DEFROST" buttons
3. Read the remaining climate buttons
tcs.expected_result:
1. The CLIMATE OFF screen is displayed
2. The power button reads ON, and "MAX DEF" and "REAR DEFROST" are not greyed out
3. The remaining climate buttons are greyed out
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)

tcs.split_reason: §8.2.2 之拆分，依 75 §1 之判準（**條文列舉之項即拆分之維度**）：本節之條文逐字列舉其觸發 —— 「Actions on rear defrost, heated/vented seats or heated wheel don t reactivate climate (climate still off)」—— 故一觸發一條。三個控制各自可失效；且三者所需之配備不同，故其 PC 依 R-C28 第一問各自具名。 （**判準之反面**：條文以泛稱表述而由作者挑樣者不拆，其樣本為 interaction data，§4.5。）
